newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia official sees 1997 IMF deal next month.
newsitem.headline: Russia official sees 1997 IMF deal next month.

text.p: A deputy Russian finance minister said on Thursday he expected the government and the International Monetary Fund to reach agreement on Moscow's 1997 economic programme next month.
"We assume that we will finish talks completely in February," Deputy Finance Minister Oleg Vlyugin told a news conference.
"That means a document will be ready, prepared by experts, ministries, the authorities and the International Monetary Fund which satisfies both the IMF and the government."
An IMF delegation arrived in Russia this week to examine Russia's latest economic indicators and look at government plans for 1997, and the experts are due to stay around 10 days.
The IMF last year approved a three-year $10 billion loan for Russia but detailed plans must be drawn up each year before the funds can be paid out.
